items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: Well, there was, there was, uh, King John.

ctx.x: Sure. But he was standing on Jackson Avenue and, what is it, Parade? Block of Four, LaSalle. He was standing right on that corner, because I walked out the parade and went and spoke. He said, I got to leave right away, otherwise I'd follow you to talk with you, you know, because you wouldn't come to Baton Rouge and play with him. He was a very good musician. Is that this year? Oh, no, that was last year. Well, there was, there was, uh, King John.
I remember one last year that way it started. It was a Mason's parade. Yeah, right.
